external/spacetimedb-maincloud.txt

WHAT THIS IS FOR
  Part C's published SpacetimeDB database and permission setup. No credentials belong here.

PUBLISHED
  SpacetimeDB version: 2.13.0 (latest stable verified Oct 24, 2026)
  Database name (STDB_DB): agent-cowork
  Display name: Agent Cowork
  Host (STDB_HOST): https://maincloud.spacetimedb.com
  Identity: c200265232fd2ba44e83549a9d038d6ac7ca0b3e889f5b00bcf84cdbac0132a1
  Dashboard: https://spacetimedb.com/agent-cowork

ACCESS
  Owner-only by default. Only the configured Owner can approve Reader/Editor membership.
  Opening the link or signing in does not grant access. Public query names expose authenticated
  views; backing tables, connection state, schedules, and membership are private.
  Read module/ACCESS.md for the sign-in, public-identity approval, and revocation workflow.
  Maincloud dashboard collaborators govern platform administration and are separate from this
  module access list. They are not automatically synchronized.

CREDENTIALS
  Each user signs in locally with spacetime login. Public identity is shown by login show.
  Never share login show --token output. Agents use each user's own signed-in session; their
  session/credential store or process memory supplies HTTP/WS authentication.
  No API key or auth token was copied into this repo or a project .env. CLI authentication is
  managed only by the CLI sign-in store.

DEPLOY AND GENERATE
  Official installation: https://spacetimedb.com/install
  Module package and required compiler options follow the official TypeScript init template.
  npm run module:generate invokes module/generate.mjs, restores the extractor's omitted None
  naming policy, and verifies untouched official bindings against the shared query contract.
  Set public STDB_DB in the publishing process. First deploy also sets ACCESS_OWNER_IDENTITY
  to the Owner's public identity (not a secret); future publishes preserve server configuration.
  See module/README.md and module/manage.mjs. Never force-delete data to get a publish through.

VERIFIED
  Module datastore authorization tests, generation guard tests, and real local HTTP/WebSocket
  role/revocation tests pass. The empty legacy tables were replaced without row loss and with
  --delete-data=never. The hosted owner can read; anonymous reads/writes return 403 Forbidden.
  Membership starts empty, so only the configured Owner has access until explicitly approved.
